_meta.description: TRUST REGISTER — the single owner-edited place an address becomes 'known' on thealliancedao.com. Every entry says HOW it was verified, by whom, when, with a link. No source, no trust. The address-catalog cron merges this with the older wallets.json / known_contracts.json (which only carry a bare 'verified:true' — published as method 'owner') and the per-DAO registries, and publishes catalog/trusted/current.json — the ONE file the catalog page, the help agent's audit, the DAO page and the news cards all read.

verified.method: one of: chain | github | scv_audit | oak_audit | owner | project_team | dao_registry | past_prop | docs
verified.ref: what exactly: repo path, audit title, prop id, team member handle, LCD query…
verified.url: where anyone can check it without trusting this site (optional but strongly preferred)
verified.by: who did the check (DeFi_Patriot | project team member handle | cron name)

methods.chain: a live capture queries this address every run and the response matches the expected contract schema / it is listed by the gauge controller / it is a pool in the DEX snapshot
methods.github: the contract's source repo is public and the deployed code_id checksum matches the build
methods.scv_audit: covered by a published SCV Security audit report
methods.oak_audit: covered by a published Oak Security audit report
methods.owner: labeled by DeFi_Patriot from direct knowledge (a human label, not chain proof)
methods.project_team: confirmed by a named member of the project's team (ref = handle)
methods.dao_registry: present in a DAO's own vetted contract registry (dao-originations/<dao>/governance/registry.json)
methods.past_prop: an executed proposal already interacted with this address (ref = prop id); precedent, not endorsement
methods.docs: listed in the protocol's own documentation
